sources.entry: Shopware Community Edition - PHP based open source e-commerce software made in Germany. (Demo, Source Code) MIT PHP

summary.one_liner: Shopware 6 is an open source, headless e-commerce platform built on Symfony and Vue.js 3 that can also be used as an e-commerce framework.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Shopware 6 as a ready-to-use shopping cart system that is also a vendor dependency in a Symfony flex project. It is API-first and can run headless. Functionality can be extended through plugins, which are Symfony bundles loaded into the application with direct access to the process and database, or through apps, described as a lighter approach needing little Shopware-specific knowledge. The README recommends the App System for extensions. It points to a community store with more than 3,100 extensions and to developer docs for extension guides. Installation on-premise is via the flex template, with a web-based installer mentioned. The README does not list specific shop features beyond these.
use_cases: Run an online shop with a shopping cart
Build a headless commerce backend with an API
Develop custom e-commerce extensions or plugins
Build a shop on a Symfony project as a framework dependency
Add functionality to a shop through apps or plugins
how_to_run: Install Shopware on-premise through the flex template (see installation docs)
Use the web-based installer to complete setup
For local development, follow the development environment setup described in CONTRIBUTING.md
notable: Usable as an e-commerce framework and as a Symfony flex vendor dependency
Two extension models: apps (preferred) and Symfony-based plugins
Community store with more than 3,100 extensions
caveats: Commercial plans unlock additional functionality for on-premise shops
Contributors must sign a Contributor License Agreement (CLA) assigning rights to use their code to shopware AG
keywords: open source alternative to hosted shop platforms
